cases.name: Only current internal Admin identity may authorize or use the Admin MCP
Unregistered redirects, different resource audiences and plain PKCE are rejected
Denying consent needs no login and never issues an authorization code
Authorization nonce is bound to the pending request and can be consumed only once
Codes and bearer credentials remain bound to the client, audience and Admin membership
Expired access credentials cannot read any MCP tools or records
Membership changes invalidate access and refresh credentials immediately
A password change revokes all delegated MCP connections through the database trigger
All business domains can be paged while SQL identifiers and sensitive columns fail closed
